scope: Actual production TypeScript with Cocos lifecycle/GPU doubles, plus actual geometry bounds. Not a Creator/WeChat/device performance pass.
checks: Closed→opened 650ms easing→closed; hidden pauses/camera off; resume; static target stops after draw; one isolated camera and 9 live mesh groups
Hide between GPU allocation and first draw defers readback until visible, preventing false blank-target failure
100 repeated closed/claimed entries release all 9 meshes, 6 materials, texture/frame/effect reference and draw callback
Dispose-before-load, missing effect, and partial target allocation failure are bounded with zero retained resources
Disabled and late-arriving camera conflicts are caught; all-transparent first GPU target is rejected before ready
Layer collision fails closed and does not alter any existing camera/layer/light settings
Animation-time mesh creation and mesh setter exceptions become error, display actual view fallback text, and release both old/candidate meshes plus all GPU resources
Short (16 opaque pixels), empty, null and throwing pixel rows fail closed before ready and leave zero GPU resources
101 lid angles use the same union-bounds camera with >10% full-size margin, no clipped lid and no camera breathing
4396 triangles: finite positions, matching normals, valid 16-bit indexes, outward winding, independently transformable lid
